audience: SaaS marketers who run email automation and track people in Encharge

useCases.title: Look up a person and see their tags and segments
useCases.text: The AI looks up up to 20 people by email, userId or Encharge id and returns all fields, tags and segment data. You get a quick profile of each person.

useCases.title: List the people in a segment
useCases.text: The AI lists the dynamic segments with their conditions, then lists the people in one segment with paging and chosen person fields.

useCases.title: Check the custom fields you collect about people
useCases.text: The AI lists all person fields, built-in and custom, with name, title, type and whether the field is read-only. It helps before you update people.

useCases.title: Add or remove tags, or unsubscribe a person
useCases.text: The AI adds tags to a person, removes tags, or unsubscribes the person so Encharge sends no more email. The person stays in Encharge.

useCases.title: Create or update a person, or track an event
useCases.text: The AI creates a person or updates the one with the same email, userId or Encharge id, and can record an event such as "Registered user" for a person. Only the fields you pass are set.
